definitions.ask: How should the idle label format the minutes part?

choices.label: Unpadded as requested (0h0m, 0h45m, 3h5m); the label widens by one digit as minutes pass 9
Two-digit minutes (0h00m, 0h45m, 3h05m); the label width holds steady within each hour

definitions.why: literal matches the requested <H>h<M>m format exactly

definitions.ask: How should the mac pom behave on a Mac whose installed bob predates --worked?

choices.label: Older bob exits 2 on --worked and the item hides until bob is reinstalled
Retry without --worked so an older bob shows NO POMODORO; keeps a permanent compat branch

definitions.why: a hidden item is a loud reinstall signal and no compat shim lingers

definitions.ask: Should the Mac Menu Bar Pomodoro Indicator glossary strand be corrected to describe the worked-total idle label?
definitions.corrects: Empty output shows a green `NO POMODORO` with no tomato, which flashes as a green pill for its first minute on screen and then for one minute in every ten, restarting that cycle whenever the label reappears or the Mac wakes or unlocks.
